# Tripp Fitzner — District Attorney, Middle Judicial Circuit of Georgia

John A. "Tripp" Fitzner III is the elected District Attorney of the Middle Judicial
Circuit of Georgia, serving Candler, Emanuel, Jefferson, Toombs, and Washington
counties. Elected in 2020; took office January 2021. Career prosecutor: the
circuit's first full-time juvenile court prosecutor (2000), child abuse
prosecutor, Chief Assistant District Attorney (2009-2020), District Attorney
since 2021. The office prosecutes all felonies in the five counties and
represents the State on appeal.

Office: 114 Jefferson Street, Swainsboro, GA 30401. Phone: (478) 237-7846.
Email: tripp@trippfitzner.net
Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.
Open records official: Investigator Rocky Davis, jrdavis@pacga.org, (912) 526-5211.

Key pages:
- /about.html — biography
- /record.html — six years of closed-case data (public record), major cases
- /circuit.html — what the DA does, the grand jury, appeals, each county
- /victims.html — victim services, including bilingual advocates
- /files.html — Use of Force Protocol, Early Intervention Program guide and forms
- /feed.xml — updates from the office (RSS)

Record highlights (from the office's closed-case disposition logs, 2020-2025):
5,811 cases closed; 2,910 convictions; convictions upheld in every appellate
review of this tenure; child sex-trafficking prosecution recognized by the U.S.
Attorney General in March 2026; Gang Prosecution Unit established with the GBI
in 2024; Early Intervention Program (O.C.G.A. 15-18-80) diverts eligible
lower-level cases.
